summary: PostgreSQL visibility database migration from 1.29 to 1.30.4 fails due to missing btree_gin extension for GIN index creation. Additionally, the new GENERATED ALWAYS AS STORED column causes PostgreSQL to rewrite all rows in the table, creating prohibitive downtime for large tables (30M+ rows).
userImpact: Users cannot upgrade to version 1.30.4 without either experiencing complete migration failure or requiring significant downtime for large visibility tables.
rootCause: GIN index creation requires btree_gin extension which may not be installed; GENERATED ALWAYS AS STORED column forces PostgreSQL to rewrite all rows, causing severe performance degradation on large tables.
proposedFix: Install btree_gin extension before migration with conditional check. Investigate alternative schema migration strategy to avoid sequential table rewrite for performance issue.
workaround: Manually install btree_gin extension before running migration: CREATE EXTENSION btree_gin;
keyQuote: pq: data type character has no default operator class for access method "gin"
